Strategy: Fill half the bin. Prefer the bin where the item takes half the residual, leaving the other half free: balanced use that neither crams the item into the tightest slot nor strands an empty bin. Score by distance from a fill fraction of one half, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the half-full bin is not the tightest. It may help by keeping every placement balanced, but may fail by passing up tight fits for half-empty bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(item / r - 1 / 2)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Half-fill targeting: score by -abs(item/r - 1/2), prefer residual = 2*item.
